summary: Users unable to login via Okta SSO with token timeout
root_cause: Clock skew discrepancy between identity provider and auth gateway
resolution: Increased clock skew tolerance to 360 seconds and refreshed SAML signing certificate metadata.

summary: High latency and connection pool exhaustion during batch processing
root_cause: Unclosed connections in legacy batch reporting queries
resolution: Applied patch v4.1.2 enabling auto-reap of idle connections after 60 seconds.
